# Apexion-X BOM (2026-10-21)

> **Historical note (2026-10-21).** This records the first BOM summary at that date. For current figures see the [D3 BOM workbook](../../bom/D3_Apexion-X_BOM.xlsx) and the [Rev 06A hardware notes](../../bom/README.md).

Apexion-X was formerly named "TV06+ fixed" (renamed 2026-10-29). It is derived from the Terminal Velocity TV06+.

The full BOM was produced as a spreadsheet (later superseded by the [D3 BOM workbook](../../bom/D3_Apexion-X_BOM.xlsx)). It was built from the Fusion design now named "Apexion-X" and has 4 tabs: BOM, Printed parts, Extrusion cut list, Fasteners. The Dragon Burner toolhead is a single line pointing to its own BOM. Related: [2026-10-21-10mm-rods](../design-reviews/2026-10-21-10mm-rods.md), [2026-10-22-round3-fixes](../design-reviews/2026-10-22-round3-fixes.md), [2026-10-19-screw-list](2026-10-19-screw-list.md).

## Headline numbers
- 2020 extrusion: 25 pieces, about 12.4 m in total.
  - The "495" and "660" pieces are modeled at 500 and 650 mm.
- 138 printed parts. 57 of them changed in the fixes and need their STLs re-exported (marked on the Printed parts tab).
- 316 screws.
- 134 T-nuts: 78 M3, 18 M4, 38 M5.
- 76 M3 heat-set inserts, plus 22 spare insert holes.
- Linear motion:
  - 6 Ø10 rods cut from the SV06 Plus
  - 4 LM10UU and 2 LM10LUU bearings
  - MGN12 rail (345 mm) + MGN12H carriage
- 2 NEMA17 17HS19-2004S (A/B) and 3 Z steppers with lead screws.

## XY-joint set screws (added 2026-10-21)
- Each lower XY joint has one Ø3.3 hole at 30° off vertical, ending at the LM10LUU. Ø3.3 is the M4 tap drill, so tap it M4 and use an **M4x8 set screw**.
- The set screw sits flush with the surface, has about 8 mm of thread and touches the bearing. Modeled as hardware idx 513–514.
- The hole axis passes 0.7–0.9 mm off the rod centre. It was already 0.45 mm off before the pocket was re-centred. That's fine for clamping.

## Not modeled / to decide (yellow rows in the BOM)
- GT2 belt length.
- Idler pulleys and bearings.
- T8 lead-screw nuts.
- Mainboard, PSU and wiring.
- Rubber feet: 4 needed, only 1 modeled.
- Three unidentified modules near the IEC inlet (Solid2–4.stp).
- Unnamed gantry parts (PRODUCT_NAME_1…9).
- Heater pad cut-outs.
- Panel sheet material.

## Fix to the screw list
The screw list's M3 T-nut total was 2 short, because the M3x25 + washer hinge screws weren't counted. It now says 78, matching the model.
